lines.text: Endmin! I have some great news!
I've officially been appointed the project lead for the Purification Node! I'm going to keep researching water treatment systems from now on!
And I recently discovered this —
Huh? What's this?
Yes! They mentioned a highly feasible efficiency enhancement plan for water treatment in their thesis! It's a bit outdated now ... but it's really inspiring!
A device modified according to this plan wouldn't just process polluted water, it could even extract some valuable materials from it!
The whole thing is still in its experimental phase, though... I'll probably need a couple more rounds of adjustments before the modifications are fully complete.
I've already implemented some new modifications to the device. Endmin, you're welcome to come and test it out anytime!

options: Is this more research left behind by your seniors?

scenes.summary: You run into a watchguard who came rushing in. From him, you learn that this was the place where Lu Lingxiang's seniors once worked on a water treatment device known as the purification node.

lines.text: There you are! Finally!
I heard the commotion from outside and rushed in to check on you. What happened?
Thank goodness! The Blight Tide didn't wreck this place.
Ah, takes me back. We used to have a few Tianshi disciples like you, tinkering with some water treatment system research right here... Shame they seemed to run into some major roadblock later on.
What? Water treatment system? You mean ... could you be talking about the "Purification Node" my seniors were researching back then?
Beats me. But rather than listening to me, why not go see for yourself?
Whew... Good thing the materials here were so well-stocked. I actually made it! Look, Endmin—
They never managed to solve it in the end. Had to give up... This place just fell quiet ever since.
It really was them... What a shame... They were so close...
Endmin, I want to try! While I was looking through these records, I got some ideas. I might be able to fulfill my seniors' wish! We can't let their hard work go to waste!
This is it! The Purification Node my seniors wanted to create!

scenes.summary: Lu decides to revive her seniors' unfinished project, the Purification Node, to finally let the water treatment sector fulfill its true purpose. In the end, you all give the project a new name.

lines.text: So that water treatment system ... you really built it?
Yep! All done! The Purification Node is up and running.
I'll write up a report for Tianshi Zhuang immediately. I'll tell her the Type-C Tianshi Pillar is operational again, and that the water treatment sector can finally serve its true purpose.
Peach blossoms everywhere... Today really is a wonderful day. We accomplished something truly remarkable.
Huh? Me?!
That's right, you name it! If the Endmin says so!
Since you've chosen to carry this legacy forward... I can think of no one more fitting to give it its name.
Then, um, Endmin ... do you have any suggestions? I'm not really good at naming things...
Pfft — Hah! The core modules would definitely love a name like that.
If my seniors hadn't left behind all that precious research, none of this would exist now... It really is a "Legacy's Flow".
That name is so beautiful, and it fits the scenery here perfectly... I love it! Let's go with that one!
I'll always remember this name ... and I'll make sure to tell the story behind it to everyone who comes here.
Thank you. Every one of you.
Once all the devices are repaired, the Test Area should be ready for full operation again!

options: Perhaps you could name this project?
